dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Keep going. Whatever challenges lie ahead, you'll make mincemeat of them.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: At least, that's the fate that your allies have foretold.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: What about me? My role is to be your loyal and dedicated assistant, of course. Why else would I leave the comfort of my home?
